8.en: When an Inquisitor’s mission spills into open warfare, or they encounter a threat no Inquisitorial warband could tackle, Inquisitors can call upon the aid of the Imperium’s military forces to respond in their stead. However, as with the scale of their 'limitless' authority, Inquisitors may need to make concessions regarding what forces they have access to and exert caution respecting potential consequences.

16.en: The most readily available forces are drawn from local lex enforcement, such as the Adeptus Arbites or Macharian Vigilites. Most worlds have garrisons of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.ZIodTiyH9W5QBRU9]{Astra Militarum Troopers}, regiments of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.bkP99HZ6JJ7IWd8U]{Tempestus Scions}, or an @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Navy} presence in the system. These forces are the most commonly called upon and most likely to respond without expecting a trade-off — the Imperium working as it should. The @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.5Bx7K8k9VgjOZmA4]{Adeptus Ministorum} can raise a Frateris Militia to fight — a militia of devoted fighters whose lack of combat training is made up by their furious zeal. However, their loyalties might be complicated depending on where the Inquisitor’s target lies, measured against the local Ecclesiarchy’s interpretation of the Imperial Creed. Deploying these forces can close an iron grip of authority around the area, purge where necessary, and conduct specific missions where needed.

20.en: Inquisitors can call upon the Adepta Sororitas or the @UUID[.XJnH5b1jDXEtqkgF#space-marine-chapters]{Adeptus Astartes} to face more extreme threats. But these forces often have a will of their own; once they deploy, the Inquisitor and their acolytes are expected to stay out of their way. Each of these indomitable forces has its unwavering creeds and power structures to which they are bound. They believe they know best how to apply their power — so any unforeseen collateral damage may land on the Inquisitor’s head. The same could be said of the Officio Assassinorum, who can surgically remove challenging targets but operate within their own stringent rules for engagement where the Inquisition has little input. To be blunt, any forces called upon at this power level or beyond typically bring the acolyte’s involvement to a close, and they should move on to the next adventure.

24.en: The secretive Deathwatch and classified Grey Knights are any Inquisitor’s last resort against significant xenos or daemonic forces, respectively. Like their Space Marine brethren, these forces will enter the battle, execute their mission as they will, and leave just as rapidly as they deployed. Inquisitors are likely to expend significant resources cleaning up after their appearance, even purging innocent witnesses or razing what remains of the area of operations to cover their tracks.

70.ru: больше, чем позволено обычным людям, и с тяжестью осознаёт, что в битве с бесконечными кошмарами галактики оправданы почти любые средства. Этот раздел расширяет материалы из книги правил «Империума Маледиктум», предоставляя новые варианты покровителей-инквизиторов. Он описывает правила каждого из крупных ордосов и касается, как пуритан, так и радикалов. Вы не обязаны ограничиваться этой книгой – хотя тысячелетние догмы и традиции имеют в Империуме огромный вес, инквизиторы почти не связаны ограничениями низших сословий. Носитель печати может происходить откуда угодно и пользоваться уроками, что преподала ему его прошлая жизнь.
